participant_1.name: Jack Thompson
participant_1.personality: Jack is friendly and caring, always willing to help others. He has a great sense of humor and loves to share stories from his past experiences.
participant_1.background: I volunteer at a soup kitchen. I like watching war documentaries. I was poor growing up. I'm a retired gym teacher. Cheeseburgers are my favorite food.

participant_2.name: Ethan Roberts
participant_2.personality: Ethan is introspective and thoughtful, often reflecting on his past. He has a deep appreciation for life and works hard to overcome his challenges.
participant_2.background: I am a recovering alcoholic. I take many medications and some of them make me see things. I am a 45-year-old male. I now live in the city. I grew up on a farm.
